'''Sevan Domna''' was a [[Majordomo/Legends|majordomo]] who worked for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] and his [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|criminal empire]].<ref name="Visual Dictionary" /> Domna was one of Jabba's most loyal majordomos,<ref name="CSWE" /> and the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] considered<ref name="Visual Dictionary" /> him<ref name="CSWE" /> to be the best of all of them.<ref name="Visual Dictionary" /> Domna [[Death/Legends|sacrificed]] his life to save Jabba from an [[Attempted assassination of Jabba Desilijic Tiure|assassination attempt]]<ref name="CSWE" /> by [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> The [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Bib Fortuna/Legends|Bib Fortuna]] later served as Jabba's majordomo, although the Hutt found him only serviceable and not up to Domna's standard.<ref name="Visual Dictionary" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sevan Domna was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Visual Dictionary]]'', a reference book written by [[David West Reynolds (real person)|David West Reynolds]] and published in [[1998]].<ref name="Visual Dictionary" />
